name: Music Rights Checker
description: Investigate song copyright, monetization permissions, and platform music policies with Jukebox integration.

issues.info: Report bugs, inaccurate licence classifications, or compatibility issues on GitHub Issues. Include the song ID, source type, and Geode version.

enabled.name: Enable Music Rights Checker
enabled.description: Show music rights indicators on song widgets and Jukebox menus.

backend-url.name: Backend API URL
backend-url.description: Base URL for the centralized Music Rights Checker v1 API (must use https://, or http://127.0.0.1 for local development).

request-timeout-seconds.name: Request timeout (s)
request-timeout-seconds.description: Maximum seconds to wait for backend API responses before falling back to local cache.

auto-check-songs.name: Auto-check active songs
auto-check-songs.description: Automatically query cached or live rights status when opening a level page.

show-in-jukebox-list.name: Show badges in Jukebox NONG list
show-in-jukebox-list.description: Add a non-invasive rights-check button to songs inside Jukebox's NONG management popup.

show-in-compact-cells.name: Show in compact song cells
show-in-compact-cells.description: Display rights badges inside compact list cells in addition to full level song widgets.

share-local-file-hash.name: Send SHA-256 hash for local NONG files
share-local-file-hash.description: When enabled, computes a local SHA-256 digest of locally imported NONG files to help match existing shared licence records. Local audio files themselves are NEVER uploaded.
